rules.basis: Launches a kernel; requires unique activity correlation in A.
Submits memory work; actual synchronization records retain priority. Async is not a guarantee of nonblocking execution.

Returns the function handle for a kernel and current context; no documented device-work submission or completion-wait operation. Not a claim of zero host blocking or absent internal resource contention.
Reads capture status, does not begin/end capture or wait for stream completion. Capture conflict/error and contradictory activity/sync evidence are not eligible.
